title: Content Localization: Translate Your Content Items | Orchard Core
description:
A site in several languages needs the same page in each language, kept together and edited separately.

The Content Localization module provides the Localization part. Each translation is a content item of its own, linked to the others, with its own content and its own publication status. You create translations from the editor or from the content items list, and find them by culture.
